name: Rinjin ni Kowasareteiku Ore no Tsuma
original_name: 隣人に壊されていく俺の妻
source:
While going on a business trip, Kazuki receives a mysterious link. When he click on it out of curiosity, he sees a video of a woman who looks like his wife being violated. After returning from the trip and carefully questioning his wife, he is relieved to see that everything seems normal.

One day, a man named Kanamori Yuuji moves to the vacant room next door. Despite his scary appearance, he is quite polite. Thus, Kazuki's anxiety quickly vanishes. And because of that, he doesn't notice his wife's gradually change since Yuuji came.

[Translated from [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/71rinzin/story01.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
一树出差时收到了神秘的链接。当他出于好奇点击它时，他看到了一个看起来像他妻子的女人被侵犯的视频。旅行回来后，仔细询问了妻子，看到一切正常，他松了口气。

有一天，一位名叫金森雄二的男子搬到了隔壁的空房间。尽管他的外表很可怕，但他很有礼貌。这样一来，一树的不安很快就消失了。正因为如此，他并没有注意到自雄二到来以来妻子逐渐发生的变化。

[翻译自[url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/71rinzin/story01.html]官方网站[/url]]
